2: """Extract shell-like commands from README content and classify them."""
3: 
4: from __future__ import annotations
5: 
6: import argparse
7: import json
8: import re
9: from pathlib import Path
10: from typing import Dict, List, Optional
11: 
12: 
13: CODE_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(r"```(?P<lang>[^\n`]*)\n(?P<body>.*?)```", re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE)
14: # Bare ">" is deliberately excluded: it marks markdown blockquotes (prose),
15: # not shell prompts, and matching it turns README notes into commands.
16: INLINE_CMD_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:\$|PS> )\s*(.+)$")
17: # Angle-bracket placeholders (<PATH/TO/DATASET>, <NUM_NODES>) mean the command
18: # cannot run verbatim: it needs researcher-supplied values first.
19: PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r"<[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 _./:-]*>")
20: HEADING_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<marks>#{1,6})\s+(?P<title>.+?)\s*$")
21: COMMAND_PREFIXES = (
22:     "python ",
23:     "python3 ",
24:     "pip ",
25:     "pip3 ",
26:     "conda ",
27:     "bash ",
28:     "sh ",
29:     "chmod ",
30:     "export ",
31:     "set ",
32:     "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=",
33:     "./",
34:     "accelerate ",
35:     "torchrun ",
36:     "deepspeed ",
37:     "make ",
38:     "docker ",
39: )
40: 
41: 
42: def collect_headings(readme_text: str) -> List[Dict[str, object]]:
43:     headings: List[Dict[str, object]] = []
44:     offset = 0
45:     inside_fence = False
46:     for line in readme_text.splitlines(keepends=True):
47:         if line.lstrip().startswith("```"):
48:             inside_fence = not inside_fence
49:             offset += len(line)
50:             continue
51:         if inside_fence:
52:             # "# comment" lines inside fenced code blocks are not headings.
53:             offset += len(line)
54:             continue
55:         matched = HEADING_RE.match(line.strip())
56:         if matched:
57:             headings.append(
58:                 {
59:                     "offset": offset,
60:                     "level": len(matched.group("marks")),
61:                     "title": matched.group("title").strip(),
62:                 }
63:             )
64:         offset += len(line)
65:     return headings
66: 
67: 
68: def nearest_heading(headings: List[Dict[str, object]], offset: int) -> Optional[str]:
69:     current: Optional[str] = None
70:     for heading in headings:
71:         if int(heading["offset"]) > offset:
72:             break
73:         current = str(heading["title"])
74:     return current
75: 
76: 
77: def infer_section_category(section: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
78:     if not section:
79:         return None
80:     lowered = section.lower()
81:     if any(word in lowered for word in ["inference", "usage", "demo", "example", "text-to-image", "image-to-image", "transcribe"]):
82:         return "inference"
83:     if any(word in lowered for word in ["evaluation", "evaluate", "benchmark", "metrics", "validation"]):
84:         return "evaluation"
85:     if any(word in lowered for word in ["training", "train", "finetune", "fine-tune", "pretrain"]):
86:         return "training"
87:     return None
88: 
89: 
90: def infer_section_kind(section: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
91:     if not section:
92:         return None
93:     lowered = section.lower()
94:     if any(word in lowered for word in ["install", "installation", "setup", "environment", "requirements"]):
95:         return "setup"
96:     if any(word in lowered for word in ["download", "checkpoint", "weights", "dataset", "data preparation"]):
97:         return "asset"
98:     if any(word in lowered for word in ["usage", "demo", "example", "inference", "evaluation", "training", "text-to-image", "image-to-image", "quick start", "quickstart", "getting started"]):
99:         return "run"
100:     return None
101: 
102: 
103: # The entrypoint script name is the strongest category signal: flags like
104: # --eval_iters on a train.py command must not flip training into evaluation
105: # (that would bypass the training-authorization gate downstream).
106: SCRIPT_CATEGORY_HINTS = [
107:     (re.compile(r"\b(?:pre)?train\w*\.py\b"), "training"),
108:     (re.compile(r"\b(?:eval\w*|benchmark\w*|validate|test)\.py\b"), "evaluation"),
109:     (re.compile(r"\b(?:sample|generate|infer\w*|predict|demo)\w*\.py\b"), "inference"),
110: ]
111: 
112: 
113: def classify(command: str, section: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
114:     section_category = infer_section_category(section)
115:     if section_category:
116:         return section_category
117: 
118:     lowered = command.lower()
119:     for pattern, category in SCRIPT_CATEGORY_HINTS:
120:         if pattern.search(lowered):
121:             return category
122: 
123:     def any_word(words: List[str]) -> bool:
124:         return any(re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(word)}\b", lowered) for word in words)
125: 
126:     if any_word(["infer", "inference", "predict", "generate", "sample", "demo", "transcribe"]) or any(
127:         token in lowered for token in ["txt2img", "img2img", "whisper ", "amg.py"]
128:     ):
129:         return "inference"
130:     if any_word(["eval", "evaluate", "evaluation", "validation", "validate", "benchmark", "score"]):
131:         return "evaluation"
132:     if any_word(["train", "training", "finetune", "pretrain"]) or any(
133:         token in lowered for token in ["fine-tune", "pre-train"]
134:     ):
135:         return "training"
136:     return "other"
137: 
138: 
139: def command_kind(command: str, section: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
140:     section_kind = infer_section_kind(section)
141:     if section_kind:
142:         return section_kind
143: 
144:     lowered = command.lower().strip()
145:     setup_prefixes = (
146:         "pip install",
147:         "pip3 install",
148:         "conda install",
149:         "conda env create",
150:         "conda create",
151:         "conda activate",
152:         "python -m pip install",
153:         "git clone",
154:         "cd ",
155:     )
156:     asset_prefixes = ("wget ", "curl ", "mkdir ", "tar ", "unzip ", "7z ", "aria2c ")
157:     if lowered.startswith(setup_prefixes):
158:         return "setup"
159:     if lowered.startswith(asset_prefixes):
160:         return "asset"
161:     if "--help" in lowered or " -h" in lowered:
162:         return "smoke"
163:     return "run"
164: 
165: 
166: def looks_like_command(line: str) -> bool:
167:     candidate = re.sub(r"^(?:\$|PS> )\s*", "", line.strip())
168:     if not candidate or candidate.startswith("#"):
169:         return False
170:     if candidate.startswith(("python", "pip", "conda", "bash", "sh", "make", "docker")):
171:         return True
172:     if candidate.startswith(COMMAND_PREFIXES):
173:         return True
174:     if re.search(r"\s--[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", candidate):
175:         return True
176:     if re.search(r"\b(?:python|pip|conda|torchrun|deepspeed|accelerate|bash|sh)\b", candidate):
177:         return True
178:     if re.search(r"[\\/].+\.(?:py|sh|bat)", candidate):
179:         return True
180:     if candidate.startswith(("cd ", "ls ", "mkdir ", "wget ", "curl ", "git ")):
181:         return True
182:     return False
183: 
184: 
185: def join_continuations(block: str) -> List[str]:
186:     """Join backslash-continued shell lines into single logical commands."""
187:     joined: List[str] = []
188:     buffer = ""
189:     for raw_line in block.splitlines():
190:         line = raw_line.strip()
191:         buffer = f"{buffer} {line}".strip() if buffer else line
192:         if buffer.endswith("\\"):
193:             buffer = buffer[:-1].rstrip()
194:             continue
195:         joined.append(buffer)
196:         buffer = ""
197:     if buffer:
198:         joined.append(buffer)
199:     return joined
200: 
201: 
202: def clean_lines(block: str) -> List[str]:
203:     commands: List[str] = []
204:     for line in join_continuations(block):
205:         if not line or line.startswith("#"):
206:             continue
207:         if not looks_like_command(line):
208:             continue
209:         line = re.sub(r"^(?:\$|PS> )\s*", "", line)
210:         commands.append(line)
211:     return commands
212: 
213: 
214: def extract_commands(readme_text: str) -> Dict[str, object]:
215:     commands: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
216:     warnings: List[str] = []
217:     seen = set()
218:     headings = collect_headings(readme_text)
219: 
220:     for match in CODE_BLOCK_RE.finditer(readme_text):
221:         lang = (match.group("lang") or "").strip().lower()
222:         if lang and lang not in {"bash", "shell", "sh", "zsh", "powershell", "cmd"}:
223:             continue
224: 
225:         section = nearest_heading(headings, match.start())
226:         lines = clean_lines(match.group("body"))
227:         if not lines:
228:             continue
229: 
230:         for line in lines:
231:             if line not in seen:
232:                 commands.append(
233:                     {
234:                         "command": line,
235:                         "category": classify(line, section),
236:                         "kind": command_kind(line, section),
237:                         "section": section,
238:                         "source": "code_block",
239:                         "needs_substitution": bool(PLACEHOLDER_RE.search(line)),
240:                     }
241:                 )
242:                 seen.add(line)
243: 
244:     running_offset = 0
245:     for line in readme_text.splitlines(keepends=True):
246:         matched = INLINE_CMD_RE.match(line)
247:         if not matched:
248:             running_offset += len(line)
249:             continue
250:         command = matched.group(1).strip()
251:         if not looks_like_command(command):
252:             running_offset += len(line)
253:             continue
254:         section = nearest_heading(headings, running_offset)
255:         if command and command not in seen:
256:             commands.append(
257:                 {
258:                     "command": command,
259:                     "category": classify(command, section),
260:                     "kind": command_kind(command, section),
261:                     "section": section,
262:                     "source": "inline",
263:                     "needs_substitution": bool(PLACEHOLDER_RE.search(command)),
264:                 }
265:             )
266:             seen.add(command)
267:         running_offset += len(line)
268: 
269:     if not commands:
270:         warnings.append("No shell-like commands were extracted from the README.")
271: 
272:     counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
273:     for item in commands:
274:         category = item["category"]
275:         counts[category] = counts.get(category, 0) + 1
276: 
277:     return {
278:         "commands": commands,
279:         "counts": counts,
280:         "warnings": warnings,
281:     }
282: 
283: 
284: def main() -> int:
285:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Extract shell-like commands from a README.")
286:     parser.add_argument("--readme", required=True, help="Path to the README file.")
287:     parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit JSON output.")
288:     args = parser.parse_args()
289: 
290:     readme_path = Path(args.readme)
291:     text = readme_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
292:     data = extract_commands(text)
293: 
294:     if args.json:
295:         print(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
296:     else:
297:         for item in data["commands"]:
298:             print(f"[{item['category']}] {item['command']}")
299:         if data["warnings"]:
300:             print("Warnings:")
301:             for warning in data["warnings"]:
302:                 print(f"- {warning}")
303:     return 0
304:

6: import argparse
7: import json
8: from datetime import datetime, timezone
9: from pathlib import Path
10: from typing import Dict, List, Optional
11: 
12: 
13: KEY_FILES = [
14:     "README.md",
15:     "README",
16:     "requirements.txt",
17:     "environment.yml",
18:     "environment.yaml",
19:     "pyproject.toml",
20:     "setup.py",
21:     "setup.cfg",
22:     "Dockerfile",
23: ]
24: 
25: SIGNAL_DIRS = [
26:     "configs",
27:     "config",
28:     "scripts",
29:     "tools",
30:     "examples",
31:     "notebooks",
32:     "checkpoints",
33: ]
34: 
35: 
36: def first_existing(root: Path, names: List[str]) -> Optional[Path]:
37:     for name in names:
38:         candidate = root / name
39:         if candidate.exists():
40:             return candidate
41:     return None
42: 
43: 
44: def scan_repo(root: Path) -> Dict[str, object]:
45:     if not root.exists():
46:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"Repository path does not exist: {root}")
47: 
48:     top_level = sorted(item.name for item in root.iterdir())
49:     detected_files = [name for name in KEY_FILES if (root / name).exists()]
50:     detected_dirs = [name for name in SIGNAL_DIRS if (root / name).exists()]
51:     readme = first_existing(root, ["README.md", "README"])
52: 
53:     warnings: List[str] = []
54:     if readme is None:
55:         warnings.append("No README file was found at the repository root.")
56:     if not detected_files:
57:         warnings.append("No common environment or packaging files were detected.")
58: 
59:     return {
60:         "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
61:         "repo_path": str(root.resolve()),
62:         "readme_path": str(readme.resolve()) if readme else None,
63:         "detected_files": detected_files,
64:         "detected_dirs": detected_dirs,
65:         "structure": {
66:             "top_level": top_level,
67:             "top_level_file_count": sum(1 for item in root.iterdir() if item.is_file()),
68:             "top_level_dir_count": sum(1 for item in root.iterdir() if item.is_dir()),
69:         },
70:         "warnings": warnings,
71:     }
72: 
73: 
74: def main() -> int:
75:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Scan a repository for key reproduction signals.")
76:     parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True, help="Path to the target repository.")
77:     parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit JSON instead of a human summary.")
78:     args = parser.parse_args()
79: 
80:     data = scan_repo(Path(args.repo))
81:     if args.json:

86:         print("Detected files:", ", ".join(data["detected_files"]) or "none")
